sources.terms: No licence or redistribution statement on kargs.net/captures; the originals are not redistributed here. Excerpts of individual datagrams only (README.md).
sources.notes: Steve Karg's collection of BACnet captures (BACnet Stack author; ASHRAE SSPC 135 member): plugfest and field recordings of vendor devices, and test traffic of the BACnet Stack demo applications. github.com/EmreEkin/ICS-Pcaps BacNET/ holds 16 of these files re-saved as pcap (no licence either) and is not used separately.
